data.name: Image_Error_NotFound
data.value: Couldn't find the picture '{0}'. Check it still exists.
data.comment: Error text. {0} is the picture file name.

data.name: Image_Error_CantOpen
data.value: Couldn't open '{0}' as a picture. It may be damaged or in a format Windows can't read.
data.comment: Error text. {0} is the file name.

data.name: Image_Error_CantSave
data.value: Couldn't save the picture '{0}'. Check the folder exists and you can save there.
data.comment: Error text. {0} is the file name.

data.name: Image_Error_Rotation
data.value: Don't know the rotation '{0}'. Choose one from the list.
data.comment: Error text. {0} is the rotation name that was given.

data.name: Image_Error_Colour
data.value: Don't know the colour '{0}'. Use a name like red, or a code like #FF8800.
data.comment: Error text. {0} is the colour text that was given. Keep the example code #FF8800.

data.name: Image_Error_NoText
data.value: Type the text to put on the picture.

data.name: Image_Error_NoPictures
data.value: Choose at least one picture to combine.

data.name: Image_Error_TooLarge
data.value: The combined picture would be too large. Use fewer or smaller pictures, or turn off "Make all the same size".
data.comment: Error text. "Make all the same size" is the name of a setting of the combine pictures action and must match it.

data.name: Clipboard_Error_Busy
data.value: Another app is using the clipboard right now. Wait a moment and try again.
